text:
I'll search for the official Jinja2 3.1.6 changelog and migration guide.

That first search was too broad. I'll narrow in on the official Pallets project sources.

I've pinpointed the official changelog locations. Now I'll open those pages to pull the 3.1.6 details.

**Official Jinja2 3.1.6 Changelog:**

1. **Hosted docs - Changes:**
   `https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/changes/#version-3-1-6`

2. **GitHub source - `CHANGES.rst`:**
   `https://github.com/pallets/jinja/blob/main/CHANGES.rst`

### Version 3.1.6

> Released 2025-03-05

> Released 2025-03-05

Change:

> - The `|attr` filter does not bypass the environment’s attribute lookup, allowing the sandbox to apply its checks.

Same entry in GitHub source:

> - The `|attr` filter does not bypass the environment's attribute lookup, allowing the sandbox to apply its checks. :ghsa:`cpwx-vrp4-4pq7`

Linked security advisory:

> allowing the sandbox to apply its checks. 【0†GHSA-cpwx-vrp4-4pq7†github.com】 — line shown as `GHSA-cpwx-vrp4-4pq7`

Context for this release:

> This is the Jinja 3.1.6 security release, which fixes security issues but does not otherwise change behavior and should not result in breaking changes compared to the latest feature release.

> Changes: https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/changes/#version-3-1-6

**Migration:** No separate migration guide for 3.1.6 — it is a patch/security-only release with no behavior change other than the sandbox fix above, so upgrade `3.1.5 -> 3.1.6` requires no template/code migration.
